messages:
nisha: hey all, first-week question: where do I grab a sandbox key vs a hosted/prod key? I'm preparing a demo and want to avoid hitting rate limits or burning promo credits.

andy: welcome! sandbox keys are auto-created in Console -> Sandbox. Hosted/prod keys are in Console -> API Keys and require an org admin (billing owner) to create. Hosted keys are tied to billing so don't use them for demos unless approved.

nisha: got it. what's the usual sandbox quota and rate limit for demos? i'm worried about 429s during a live demo.

devex-bot: Default sandbox: $20 promo credits + ~40k tokens/month for new hires. Rate-limit: roughly 20 reqs/sec per key with short bursts up to ~80 for a few seconds. You may see 429s when bursts exceed the short-burst window. For demos request a temporary elevated demo key via https://go/redwood-help (choose "Demo / temporary quota").

andy: also watch the response headers for throttling: X-RateLimit-Remaining and Retry-After seconds. If you get a 429, backoff exponentially and retry after Retry-After.

nisha: great tip. any way to test heavy traffic locally without using promo credits?

andy: yes—use the staging org or a synthetic endpoint we provide for load testing. Ping me and I can request a demo key with a higher minute quota for your time slot. We usually approve a 10min elevated window for live demos.

nisha: perfect. one other thing: my demo uses embeddings and will make a lot of small calls. do embeddings use the same token quota?

devex-bot: Embeddings are billed/quoted separately as embedding-units in the Console. Sandbox credits can cover both, but large embedding workloads may need a quota bump. Request a quota increase and specify "embeddings-heavy demo".

oncall-bot: Reminder: do not hardcode keys in demo slides or public repos. Use env vars or ephemeral demos sessions.

nisha: thanks everyone, saved. andy, i'll DM you the demo time so we can get a temporary bump. :thumbsup:
